metadata.title: Concavity-Free $L^\infty$ Estimates and Stability for Fully Nonlinear Complex Equations
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we extend the $L^\infty$ estimates of Guo-Phong for fully non-linear equations on compact hermitian manifolds to a possibly indefinite reference form satisfying a uniform admissibility criterion. Furthermore, we also establish one-sided stability estimates. Neither result requires homogeneity or concavity of the nonlinear operator.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 将紧 Hermitian 流形上完全非线性复方程的 L∞ 估计推广到满足统一可容许性条件、可能不定的参考形式。
techniques: 非线性复方程先验估计
analysis.breakthrough: 不要求算子齐次或凹，仍得到上确界控制和单侧稳定性，扩展 Guo–Phong 估计的适用背景。
analysis.limitations: 取消凹性不等于取消全部结构与可容许性假设；单侧稳定性也不能直接称为任意两解的双侧稳定或高阶正则性。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
